results.title: Maxma: The AI Paid Media Team That Runs Campaigns Like a Six-Role Specialist Squad — Launchstag Editorial Reviews
results.content:
Running paid ads well across more than one channel usually means stitching together a media buyer to manage spend, a creative person to keep ad variants fresh, and someone who can read the data well enough to know what to scale and what to kill. For a lean Shopify brand or an early SaaS team, that is three hires or one overworked generalist before a single new channel gets tested. Maxma is built to be that team in software. Given a goal, it researches what is already selling for similar products, builds the ad creative and landing pages, launches after a human signs off, measures what actually moved the needle, scales the winners, pauses the losers, and keeps what it learns for the next cycle. The six named roles (Media Buyer, Analyst, Creative, Marketing Ops, Data Scientist, Engineer) [...] Maxma's primary interface is Slack, which matters more than it sounds. Instead of logging into another dashboard to check on campaigns, the team @mentions Maxma for a specific ask, such as a new search campaign, a competitor ad recreation, a performance deck, or a batch of UGC-style video ads, and gets the output back in the channel everyone already works in. The background mode is the more interesting half: Maxma also runs proactively, watching accounts and pinging the channel when it has a proposal ready, whether that is scaling a winning ad set or pausing one that is bleeding spend. That proposal always requires approval before it executes, which is the detail that makes autonomous monitoring usable for teams who are not ready to hand over unattended budget control. [...] Six-role AI team (Media Buyer, Analyst, Creative, Marketing Ops, Data Scientist, Engineer) covering the full paid-ads workflow from research to optimization in one system
 Native Slack interface for both on-demand requests and proactive background monitoring with approval pings
 Approval-by-default governance layer with configurable autonomy levels and a full change history log
 Covers 10+ channels including Google, Meta, TikTok, Microsoft, Pinterest, Reddit, LinkedIn, and newly added ChatGPT Ads, with integrations across Shopify, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and more
 Built-in incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling for measuring real incremental growth, not just platform-reported conversions
